results.selection_rule: Within 0.015 of best validation AP, then within 0.01 of minimum eligible Brier; prefer CV AP SD <= 0.04 where available; prefer logistic regression if eligible; otherwise highest AP. No test evidence used.
results.threshold_rule: Maximum validation F2 on 0.05–0.95 grid in 0.01 steps; higher threshold breaks ties. Review priority is a decision policy, not a validated clinical/business risk tier.

privacy: No raw customer profiles or IDs are included. The test-cohort arrays contain scores and binary labels only. Entered or uploaded profiles are calculated in the browser and are not sent to a prediction server.
